renderings.value: Indicates that while one action or situation is happening, another action or situation is also occurring or is in contrast.

The ～一方 grammar point is used to express that while one action or situation is taking place, another is occurring at the same time or in contrast. The clauses connected by 一方 often show simultaneous actions, opposing characteristics, or parallel developments.
Verb-casual + 一方(で), い-Adjective + 一方(で), な-Adjective + な/である一方(で), Noun + である一方(で)
一方(で): while X, on the other side Y; two sides of a situation.
While technology advances, life is getting busier.
While my Japanese improves, I feel like my English ability is declining.
While this dish is delicious, it’s a bit expensive.
While he is kind, he also has a strict side.
